author: reek
body: Hash join for equi-join predicates on large unsorted relations. Build phase: hash the smaller (build) side into a hash table. Probe phase: scan the larger (probe) side and look up matches. Keys are one or more columns per side, paired positionally. A composite key is the concatenation of every keyed value rendered by val-to-text, each part preceded by its length and a colon, therefore no arrangement of values can collide with a different arrangement.

author: reek
body: hash-join-keys is the general form; hash-join wraps a single column pair in singleton lists for the callers that join on one column.
